events.description: A man and a woman engage in mutual physical combat in a hallway: the man grabs the woman (f9), she resists and they grapple (f10–f11), he overpowers her and brings her to the floor (f12), and continues to subdue her while she is on the ground (f13–f15).
After the woman is on the floor (f12), the man remains on top of her, pinning her down and appearing to strike or control her (f13–f15), indicating an attack on a now-helpless victim.

Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat in a hallway: one person (in dark clothing) lifts and throws the other (in lighter clothing) against a side table, causing the lamp to fall and shatter.

After the initial fight, the standing individual continues to assault the now-fallen victim on the floor, including kicking and striking while the victim is incapacitated and unable to defend themselves.

A second physical confrontation occurs inside the room: a figure is seen falling backward onto the floor near a sofa, suggesting being pushed or struck; the subsequent frames show the person on the floor recovering while another stands nearby.
Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat inside a room, involving grappling, striking, and close-quarters struggle.
A person is on the floor in a vulnerable position (crawling/lying), while another individual stands over them; the posture and context suggest an attack on a helpless victim.

A man and a woman engage in intense, mutual physical combat involving grappling, throwing, and striking; the struggle moves across the room and includes use of furniture (e.g., coffee table) as part of the fight dynamics.

A man carries a woman into a bedroom and forcefully throws her onto the bed; he then mounts and restrains her while she appears distressed and struggles, indicating non-consensual physical domination.
After being thrown onto the bed, the woman actively resists by pushing and struggling against the man who is pinning her down, constituting mutual physical struggle during the assault.
A man and a woman are engaged in a physical struggle on a bed; the man is on top, gripping the woman, who appears to resist, with visible tension and forceful interaction across multiple frames.

The woman appears restrained and distressed while the man dominates her physically on the bed; her posture and facial expression (especially in f0) suggest helplessness during the struggle, consistent with abusive behavior.
A physical struggle occurs on the bed: the woman is seen actively pushing and grappling with the man, who is lying beneath her; this escalates to her sitting up abruptly while he remains restrained.

The woman, now standing over the man, appears to strike or forcefully push him while he is on the bed; his posture and facial expression suggest he is unable to effectively resist, indicating a one-sided attack on a vulnerable person.

The man is lying on his back with the woman straddling or pinning him; he shows signs of distress (open mouth, strained expression) while she maintains dominant control, consistent with ongoing mutual or non-consensual physical struggle.
